# Charity payments: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Payments to a new beneficiary must be approved by the treasurer, per the Charity Finance Rules. |
| C2 | Donor details must not be shared with third parties without permission, under the Fundraising Code. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a finance officer, I want to add a new beneficiary so that I can pay them.
US-2 As a finance officer, I want to schedule a payment run so that bills go out on time.
US-3 As a trustee, I want to see the payments made last month so that I can review them.
US-4 As a donor, I want my details kept from other organisations unless I say yes so that I am not contacted by strangers.
constraints: Payments to a new beneficiary must be approved by the treasurer, per the Charity Finance Rules.
Donor details must not be shared with third parties without permission, under the Fundraising Code.
